name: Watchlist Prune
author: Thunderhat
description: Take films off your Plex watchlist once you have watched them in Plex, and optionally after they have sat there too long.

settingsSchema.label: Enabled
settingsSchema.help: Master switch for removing films when you watch them and for the daily sweep.

settingsSchema.label: Movie libraries
settingsSchema.help: No libraries are selected by default. A watched film in one of these libraries is removed from your watchlist.

settingsSchema.label: Remove films older than (days)
settingsSchema.help: 0 turns this off. Plex does not say when a film was added to the watchlist, so the clock starts the first time this tool sees it.
